title: Coloron
description: Bounce the ball and match the color of the platform.
about:
Coloron is a browser game where you watch the color of the bouncing ball and switch the bar to the same color before it lands.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Watch the color of the bouncing ball and switch the bar to the same color before it lands.
tips: Use click / tap the bars to change the bar color.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Coloron?
faq.answer: Watch the color of the bouncing ball and switch the bar to the same color before it lands.

faq.question: Can I play Coloron in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
